title: OpenCode LSP workstation setup harness
purpose: Give low-capability agents and Windows operators one deterministic path to recover a canonical checkout, recover the Windows-facing OpenCode runtime, inspect, configure, verify, and hand off OpenCode LSP enablement without changing product code, governance, secrets, or existing OpenCode configuration.

repositoryRecovery.proofRule: Only an exact canonical GitHub origin plus expected branch/head may become the setup worktree; a non-Git folder is preserved and never upgraded in place.

runtimeRecovery.proofRule: OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND routes through the registered runtime recovery router. Recovery requires LOCALAPPDATA so the router and Inspect use the same canonical AgentSwitchboard shim/state root. The router separates command discovery from version health, verifies both the initial and post-install runtime by their exact safe command paths, treats either an absent command or a discovered command whose bounded version probe times out/fails as an OpenCode-only repair reason, pins the official installer to the deterministic $HOME/.opencode/bin recovery directory and gives that directory PATH precedence, runs the installer once inside dual timeout boundaries, proves command path plus version, writes only the canonical AgentSwitchboard shim, records runtime-recovery receipt/report evidence for terminal stages after recovery run initialization including failures before Inspect, then re-enters bounded Inspect automatically.

upstreamContract.stableLspRule: LSP is disabled by default; lsp=true enables built-in servers whose file types and prerequisites are present.
upstreamContract.configPrecedenceRule: OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT is the highest runtime config source; the generated launcher preserves inherited inline values in memory and forces lsp=true there.
upstreamContract.interactiveModelRule: The current OpenCode TUI accepts --model/-m on the top-level opencode command.
upstreamContract.v2Boundary: Current OpenCode V2 documentation accepts LSP configuration but does not provide an LSP runtime; fail closed on a detected v2 command/version.

safety.proofCeiling: Static/hosted validation proves harness structure and setup logic. Checkout recovery can prove canonical repository acquisition and exact-head isolated worktree state. Runtime-recovery receipts can prove the bounded local discovery/version/install/shim/Inspect-handoff state without persisting command output or environment contents. Workstation execution can prove OpenCode command/version resolution, immutable machine-local config artifacts, model visibility, and launcher generation. Active LSP diagnostics require opening a supported file and observing runtime behavior.
